entry.title: dotnet/efcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-07-20
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Add-Migration and Update-Database fail with warning NU1902 #38677
  • dotnet-ef fails to retrieve metadata for UNC project paths containing spaces #38675

Closed

  • ComplexCollection + ToJson(): DetectChanges throws "must be initialized to a non-null value" when a nullable nested complex property containing a collection is set to null #38632
    11.0.0
  • [dnceng-bot] Branch `efcore/release/9.0` can't be merged to Azdo internal branch #38674

PullRequests

Created

  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/10.0' => 'main' #38680
  • Bump Microsoft.DotNet.XUnitV3Extensions from 11.0.0-beta.26329.101 to 11.0.0-beta.26370.1 #38679
    area-infrastructure
  • Handle out-of-order split include rows during concurrent inserts #38676
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #38672

Merged

  • Fix DetectChanges throwing when nullable nested complex property with nested collection is set to null #38667
  • Fix OPENJSON `AS JSON` failure on Azure SQL when column type is `json` at compat level 170 #38665
  • Bump Microsoft.Azure.Cosmos from 3.61.0 to 3.62.0 #38678
    area-infrastructure

Updated

  • Query: lift GroupBy aggregates over reference navigations into pre-GroupBy joins #38668
    community-contribution
  • Cosmos: flow transactional batch failures through the execution strategy so they can be retried #38597
  • Fix JsonReaderData buffer refill to respect valid bytes on partial stream reads #38666
  • [release/9.0]: Bump Newtonsoft.Json from 13.0.3 to 13.0.4 #38654
    area-infrastructure
